title: Claim Service Fee Schedule — Northloop Protect Plans
content:
Under the Northloop Protect Plans, a service fee is set per approved claim by the covered item's price band, and only claims of the failure types listed for the plan carry it. On every plan, a collected service fee is refunded when the claim is denied.

## Service fee per approved claim (USD)

| Covered item price band (USD) | Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10.00 to 5000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

| Covered item price band (USD) | Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Protect 4-Year Accident Protection |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10.00 to 199.99 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| 200.00 to 499.99 | 49.00 | 49.00 | 49.00 |
| 500.00 to 999.99 | 89.00 | 89.00 | 89.00 |
| 1000.00 to 2500.00 | 149.00 | 149.00 | 149.00 |

## Failure types whose claims carry the service fee

| Plan | Fee-bearing failure types | Collected fee refunded when the claim is denied |
|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | None | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | None | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | None | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | Yes |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | Accidental damage, liquid damage, cracked screen | Yes |

## Reading the schedule

**Which claims carry a fee.** A claim carries the service fee only when its failure type is in the plan's fee-bearing list. The three Extended Warranty plans list no fee-bearing failure type, and their single band shows a fee of 0.00 USD.

**Which band applies.** The band is read from the covered item's price, not from the cost of the repair or the value of the settlement.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- Accidental damage claim on Protect 3-Year Accident Protection, covered item price 620.00 USD: band 500.00 to 999.99, service fee 89.00 USD.
- Cracked screen claim on Protect 2-Year Accident Protection, covered item price 180.00 USD: band 10.00 to 199.99, service fee 25.00 USD.
- Mechanical failure claim on Protect 4-Year Accident Protection, covered item price 1200.00 USD: mechanical failure is not a fee-bearing type, so the claim carries no service fee.
